entries.title: Hardened desktop relay bind on Windows
items: Desktop relay binds 127.0.0.1 and falls back to an OS-picked free port
Electron waits on a real listen promise instead of only /ping polling
Error dialog now includes the relay.log tail for diagnosis

entries.title: Fix desktop exe relay not starting
items: Retry ports on Windows EACCES (excluded port ranges), not only EADDRINUSE
Desktop shell prefers ports 39200+ to avoid clashes with :3000
Writable session data + relay.log under AppData
Open the app offline if the relay still cannot bind (Live disabled)
Fully exit on close (no leftover Track Spec process holding ports)
Fix build using stale App.jsx so Garage, Sessions, and Update appear

entries.title: Fix desktop exe port-in-use crash
items: Reuse an already-running Track Spec relay instead of crashing
Fall back to ports 3001–3009 when 3000 is busy
Stop the Electron “Uncaught Exception” dialog for EADDRINUSE
WebSocket follows the UI port when the relay serves the app

entries.title: Fix desktop exe black screen
items: Wait for the local relay before opening the UI
Electron always opens the app (not the marketing page)
Disable service workers in the desktop shell
Clearer errors if port 3000 is already in use
